customer: So I'm a college student and I've been driving this pickup truck for about two years, and honestly I need the cash for next semester more than I need the truck, plus parking on campus is a nightmare. The thing is, when I bought it the seller mentioned it had a rebuilt title because it was in some accident before, but it's run fine for me the whole time here in North Carolina. Would Northwind still be able to buy it, or does that title thing mess everything up?
agent: Thanks for reaching out, and good luck with the upcoming semester. Unfortunately, Northwind doesn't buy cars with salvage, rebuilt or flood titles, because a branded title shows the vehicle was declared a total loss and possibly rebuilt afterward. Since your truck has a rebuilt title, we're unable to make an offer on it, even though it's been running well for you. You can find more details in our article "Salvage and rebuilt titles," and there's related information in "Flood-damaged cars."
